sources.snippet: LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct is a compact, high-performance language model developed by Liquid AI, specifically optimized for on-device and edge deployment. As part of the Liquid Foundation Model (LFM) 2.5 series, it is built on a hybrid architecture that combines double-gated LIV convolution blocks with Grouped Query Attention (GQA).
